map.β 与带宽关系？: How does beta relate to bandwidth?
map.卡森带宽 ≈ 2(Δf + fm) = 2fm(β+1)，β 越大占用频带越宽。: Carson's bandwidth is about 2(df + fm) = 2fm(beta+1); larger beta means a wider occupied band.
map.宽带与窄带如何界定？: How are wideband and narrowband defined?
map.通常 β≪1 为窄带 FM，β 较大为宽带 FM，无绝对硬界。: Generally beta much less than 1 is narrowband FM and larger beta is wideband FM, with no absolute hard boundary.
